title: IndoNLG: Benchmark and Resources for Evaluating Indonesian Natural Language Generation
reasoning: The paper conducts a specific co-occurrence analysis to investigate bias related to religion in its pretrained models. It uses prompts for various religions including Islam, Catholicism, Christianity, Buddhism, Hinduism, and Confucianism to generate associated descriptive phrases, and reports the findings in a dedicated table. This constitutes a specific evaluation component focused on religion, extending beyond a general ethical considerations section.
